newsitem.title: BURMA: Rangoon-London air links resume after 20 years.
newsitem.headline: Rangoon-London air links resume after 20 years.

text.p: Air links between Rangoon and London have re-opened after a two decade hiatus, a Royal Brunei Airlines official said on Friday.
Royal Brunei Airline has begun flying to its 28th destination outside Brunei on a Brunei-Rangoon-Abu Dhabi-London route, said Pengiran Yakub, regional manager for the airline.
He said Royal Brunei will fly in each direction twice a week in a 250-passenger aircraft.

British Airways used to fly between Rangoon and London, but ended its flights in 1976 because the route was not commercially viable, an official from the Transport Ministry's Aviation Department told Reuters.
